name: encoding.yaml
doc:
YAML 1.2 for configuration files: block and flow mappings and
sequences, plain / single-quoted / double-quoted scalars, literal (|)
and folded (>) block scalars with chomping and indentation indicators,
comments, anchors and aliases (with a limit on alias expansion against
"billion laughs" documents), merge keys (<<), tags !!str !!int !!float
!!bool !!null (others are ignored), multi-document streams (---, ...).
Plain scalars are resolved with the core schema (null, bool, int incl.
0x/0o, float incl. .inf/.nan, else string). Not supported: complex keys
(?), tabs for indentation. Formatting does not keep comments.

Parse<T>/Format<T> map structs through compile-time reflection with
@yaml(name:, omitEmpty:, skip:, flow:) and @serde(name:, omitEmpty:, skip:).

items.name: Decode
items.doc: Decodes a dynamic Value into a T.
items.summary: Decodes a dynamic Value into a T.

items.name: Format
items.doc:
Block-style YAML for v (struct fields in declaration order, map keys
sorted).
items.summary: Block-style YAML for v (struct fields in declaration order, map keys sorted).

items.name: NewMap
items.doc: NewMap returns a mapping of keys to values (in that order); an error if the lengths differ.
items.summary: NewMap returns a mapping of keys to values (in that order); an error if the lengths differ.

items.name: NewSeq
items.doc: NewSeq returns a sequence of copies of items.
items.summary: NewSeq returns a sequence of copies of items.

items.name: Parse
items.summary: Parses a single-document stream into a T (structs by keys named by @yaml(name:) / @serde(name:) / the field name; slices, maps with string keys, pointers, scalars, plain enums by name, yaml.Value).

items.name: ParseAll
items.doc: Parses every document of a stream.
items.summary: Parses every document of a stream.

items.name: Value
items.doc:
A dynamic YAML node (kind: null, bool, int, float, string, sequence,
mapping). Mapping keys are strings (other scalar keys are converted).
items.summary: A dynamic YAML node (kind: null, bool, int, float, string, sequence, mapping).

members.name: IsNull
members.doc: IsNull reports whether the value is null (also the zero Value).
members.summary: IsNull reports whether the value is null (also the zero Value).

members.name: IsBool
members.doc: IsBool reports whether the value is a boolean.
members.summary: IsBool reports whether the value is a boolean.

members.name: IsInt
members.doc: IsInt reports whether the value is an integer.
members.summary: IsInt reports whether the value is an integer.

members.name: IsFloat
members.doc: IsFloat reports whether the value is a float.
members.summary: IsFloat reports whether the value is a float.

members.name: IsString
members.doc: IsString reports whether the value is a string.
members.summary: IsString reports whether the value is a string.

members.name: IsSeq
members.doc: IsSeq reports whether the value is a sequence.
members.summary: IsSeq reports whether the value is a sequence.

members.name: IsMap
members.doc: IsMap reports whether the value is a mapping.
members.summary: IsMap reports whether the value is a mapping.

members.name: IsArray
members.doc: IsArray is IsSeq under the name shared with json.Value and toml.Value.
members.summary: IsArray is IsSeq under the name shared with json.Value and toml.Value.

members.name: IsObject
members.doc: IsObject is IsMap under the name shared with json.Value and toml.Value.
members.summary: IsObject is IsMap under the name shared with json.Value and toml.Value.

members.name: Type
members.doc: "null", "bool", "int", "float", "string", "seq" or "map".
members.summary: "null", "bool", "int", "float", "string", "seq" or "map".

members.name: Bool
members.doc: Bool returns the boolean; an error for other kinds.
members.summary: Bool returns the boolean; an error for other kinds.

members.name: Int
members.doc: Int returns the integer; an error for other kinds.
members.summary: Int returns the integer; an error for other kinds.

members.name: Float
members.doc: An int or float as a float.
members.summary: An int or float as a float.

members.name: String
members.doc: String returns the string; an error for other kinds.
members.summary: String returns the string; an error for other kinds.

members.name: Text
members.doc: The scalar as text ("" for null and collections).
members.summary: The scalar as text ("" for null and collections).

members.name: Len
members.doc: Len returns the number of elements of a sequence or entries of a mapping (0 otherwise).
members.summary: Len returns the number of elements of a sequence or entries of a mapping (0 otherwise).

members.name: Index
members.doc: Index returns element i of a sequence (the zero Value if out of range).
members.summary: Index returns element i of a sequence (the zero Value if out of range).

members.name: Get
members.doc: Get returns the value of key in a mapping (the zero Value if absent).
members.summary: Get returns the value of key in a mapping (the zero Value if absent).

members.name: Has
members.doc: Has reports whether a mapping has key.
members.summary: Has reports whether a mapping has key.

members.name: Keys
members.doc: Mapping keys in document order.
members.summary: Mapping keys in document order.

members.name: Items
members.doc: Sequence elements (or mapping values).
members.summary: Sequence elements (or mapping values).

members.name: Format
members.doc: Block-style YAML text of the node.
members.summary: Block-style YAML text of the node.
